plugins.name: memory-ledger
plugins.description: Append-only ledger of settled questions, each carrying a runnable check and one signature per AI session, so confidence counts independent runs rather than asserting itself. Works standalone or as bootgear's memory gear.

plugins.name: engine
plugins.description: General autonomous task-execution loop: clarify settles task type, approach, per-domain source-of-truth, debate threshold, and autonomy scope, then execute runs unattended to a succeeded/failed /goal. Depends on converge, spec, test, review, advisor, and memory-ledger (installed automatically).

plugins.name: spec
plugins.description: Default requirements-gathering skill for engine's ticket-writing task type. Works standalone or as an engine peer, overridable per project.

plugins.name: test
plugins.description: Default test-writing, running, and triage skill for engine's bug-triage and ticket-to-pr task types. Works standalone or as an engine peer, overridable per project.

plugins.name: converge
plugins.description: Settles facts: claims pass find -> refute -> cut through separate agents, recorded in a validated append-only ledger with a computed cutoff and convergence. Works standalone (refute an existing slate) or as review's and debate's fact-settling peer.

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: Default PR-review skill for engine's pr-review task type: lens finders, a gap hunt, and converge's refute/cut stages, reported from the converge ledger. Depends on converge (installed automatically). Works standalone or as an engine peer, overridable per project.

plugins.name: advisor
plugins.description: Pair Claude Code and Codex CLI through a shared mailbox, or route a one-shot call to Codex — for a rewrite, an opinion, an adversarial review, or delegated investigation. Works standalone; engine's debate uses it for the adversarial reviewer on Claude Code. Install via `codex plugin add advisor@bootgear`.
